timing: Continuous monotonic elapsed time after compile/warmup. Includes synchronized cycle validation, bounded aggregation, telemetry and periodic replay audits; excludes the final replay. Cross-check wall-clock deltas to detect suspension when monotonic time pauses. Any host-loop gap or wall/monotonic discrepancy above 30 seconds fails. Final replay is also gap-checked. Audit cycles are excluded from primary counters.
checkpoint: Reuse the sealed showdown-chance-checkpoint-1 format and unchanged learner plan. Compare original versus restored next learner and metrics; persist exact fingerprints for later verification.
memory: Process peak/current RSS telemetry; no certified device-memory or system headroom claim.
